Membership

A Christian community with an open seat at the table.

Our GuildOur CharterGuild LifeStatement of FaithCommunity RulesMembershipLeadershipGuild Ranks

Who belongs here?

CotC is a distinctly Christian guild that welcomes both Christians and non-Christians who wish to participate in our community and respect its values.

Membership and ordinary rank advancement do not require a profession of Christian faith. Positions of spiritual and organizational leadership require Christian faith and biblical maturity.

We will not assume every member shares our beliefs, nor treat non-Christian members as second-class participants. Our desire is that everyone experiences genuine kindness, humility, and the love of Christ.

Get connected

  1. Read our Community Rules and Statement of Faith to understand the community.
  2. Join our Discord and introduce yourself.
  3. Open a ticket in the #help-desk channel in Discord and include your character name. Someone with invite privileges will coordinate a guild invite with you.
  4. Join in the conversation, invite someone to group, and get to know your guildmates.

Join our Discord ↗

Common questions

Do I have to be a Christian?

No. Everyone is welcome who respects our Christian identity and follows our community standards.

What does family-friendly mean?

We keep conversation PG, avoid profanity and explicit content, and treat others with kindness. Our full Community Rules explain the standards.

Do I need to register on this website?

No. This website is our information hub. Connect with the community through Discord and in-game.

Do I need to keep up with everyone else?

No. Some members level quickly and others take their time. There is room for different ways to enjoy the game, and participation in events is optional.
